task: GOAL-HEAL-SEC-001 — Firebase Admin SDK service-account JSON relocation to non-public storage
phase_source: Phase B.3 Security RED-team finding B3.2-001 (CRITICAL)

files_moved_on_disk.classification: DEMO key (upstream iniLabs vendor, not Le Cayenne production)

vulnerability_closure_proof: 1. public/file/service-account-file.json no longer exists on disk and is removed from git index (git rm).
2. New 'firebase_private' filesystem disk in config/filesystems.php points to storage/app/firebase (NOT symlinked into public/storage).

3. NotificationSetting::registerMediaCollections() pins the 'notification-file' media collection to firebase_private disk — admin-uploaded production Firebase JSON will land under storage/app/firebase/ instead of storage/app/public/ (the public-disk default).
4. FirebaseService::getAccessToken() resolves the JSON path via $media->getPath() on the firebase_private disk, removing the prior parse_url('/storage') public-asset coupling.
5. .gitignore adds belt-and-braces globs for /public/file/*.json|pem|key|p12|crt to prevent re-commit.
6. public/.htaccess + public/file/.htaccess add Apache-side credential extension denials (defense-in-depth).
7. scripts/deploy/nginx-deny-sensitive-files.conf provides the nginx equivalent for production deploy.

8. Sentinel FirebaseKeyStorageSecurityTest asserts (a) absent public file, (b) firebase_private disk config, (c) media collection pin, (d) FirebaseService uses Spatie path resolver, (e) .gitignore globs, (f) .htaccess deny rule — 6 tests / 21 assertions all green.
owner_action_required: Per the original task instructions: rotate the demo iniLabs Firebase key with the upstream vendor IF it's still active in project foodking-inilabs.

Owner: confirm Le Cayenne has NOT yet uploaded a REAL production Firebase Admin JSON via the admin UI in the affected period (2026-03-06 to 2026-05-23). If they have, the real key may also have been web-accessible briefly and must be rotated via Google Cloud Console + git history scrubbed via BFG.

If Le Cayenne plans to start using FCM admin push from the server in production, the admin uploads the real key via Settings > Notification (the upload flow now correctly lands it on firebase_private disk — no further action needed for the upload itself).

On a fresh deploy/clone, the DEMO seeder block (gated by $envService->getValue('DEMO')) will silently skip because storage/app/firebase/service-account-file.json is gitignored. This is correct: Le Cayenne runs in production mode (not DEMO), so the seeder branch never executes anyway.
notes_advisor_caught: Original heal prompt described a fix path that didn't account for the Spatie MediaLibrary indirection — the file isn't read by a hard-coded public_path() in NotificationService.php; it's read by FirebaseService.php via the media collection URL. Without the registerMediaCollections() disk pin, moving the source file alone would NOT prevent admin-uploaded REAL keys from landing under public/storage/ (the default MEDIA_DISK=public). The actual fix re-plumbs the disk binding via a new firebase_private disk and pins the media collection to it. The original sentinel suggestion (asserting NotificationService::storage_path(...) usage) would have been a false-positive sentinel checking for code that never existed.
